prompt: A seamlessly TILEABLE soft cloud/steam texture for a game weather overlay, SECOND layer: thinner and wispier than its companion, longer drawn-out streaks of vapour rather than dense billows, more clear space than cloud. White and very pale grey with a faint cool cyan tint. Semi-transparent throughout. No objects, no horizon, no text, no hard outlines. Must tile edge-to-edge with no visible seam. Flat top-down, no perspective, no lighting direction.
style_notes: SCALD_STEAM_WEATHER_DESIGN_1 step 6 -- overlay texture B, the SECOND panning layer (_MainTex2) for RUT_WeatherOverlay_ScaldSteam. Install to src/RimMandrake/EnvironmentalHazards/Textures/Weather/RM_ScaldSteam_B.png. It pans at a different speed and direction from A, so it must be visibly THINNER than A or the two stack into an opaque wall. See scaldsteam_overlay_a for the full note. This is a TILING texture, NOT a sprite.
